Elena (CSM): Stonewell renewal next Friday. They're asking for a temporary regional throughput bump (APAC + us-east) and an IP allowlist for two staging ranges for a live demo. Renewal is at-risk if demo fails. ticket: CS-8921
Samir (AE): How big a bump do they need? Can we do an auto-revoke after the demo window?
Priya (Support Eng): Customer baseline ~30k req/day. Expect ~3x traffic during demo on 2026-04-15 16:00 UTC. If we grant a rate window, need ops to pin routing to a burst pool to avoid noisy-neighbor impact.
Kai (Platform): We can add CIDR allowlist + a temporary rate window. Need exact CIDRs, start/end times, and desired qps. Auto-revoke (TTL) supported.
Elena (CSM): CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.8/29. Start 2026-04-15T15:30Z, end 2026-04-16T03:30Z. Target p95 latency requirement: <350ms. Also want a small SLA note for the demo.
ops-bot: Deploy request created (#ops-5278). Preflight: capacity available in apac1 + us-east-1. Estimated times: allowlist 10m, rate window 25m.
Priya (Support Eng): Quick preflight command I'm going to run (for ops reference):
```
redwoodctl config allowlist add --cidr 203.0.113.0/24 --cidr 198.51.100.8/29 --scope stonewell-staging
redwoodctl rates window create --qps 4000 --start 2026-04-15T15:30Z --end 2026-04-16T03:30Z --autorrevoke 12h
```
Samir (AE): :thumbsup: I can run the enablement dry-run and lead the prep call on 2026-04-14. Elena, I'll need the demo script and the prompt set so we can rehearse.
Elena (CSM): I'll send the demo script + runbook. Also please capture their feedback after the run — product/optimize wants any failing prompts so we can recommend quantization/config tweaks. Adding a renewal note to CS-8921.
Kai (Platform): Config update: CIDRs applied, rate window scheduled and pinned to burst-dedicated pool. Auto-revoke TTL set to 12h post-window end. Monitoring hook added: dashboard -> Stonewell / CS-8921.
ops-bot: Update: allowlist deploy complete. Rate window active at scheduled start. Alerting rule in place: burst-usage > 80% triggers paging to eng-oncall.
Elena (CSM): Great — I'll confirm times with Stonewell and schedule the enablement rehearsal. After demo we'll capture post-mortem notes and renewal readiness feedback to the renewal dossier. Thanks all!
